d: Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work!

Digital Marketing Manager at Conrad Dubai – Join our award-winning team and lead innovative digital strategies that elevate our luxury brand, strengthen online engagement, and drive direct bookings. Through compelling content, performance marketing, and seamless digital experiences, you’ll help guests discover Conrad Dubai and inspire memorable stays from the very first click – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
q: What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, our core values are the driving force behind our success and shape the qualities we look for in every team member. As part of the award-winning Conrad Dubai team , you’ll bring these values to life through thoughtful service, attention to detail, and memorable experiences that define luxury hospitality.

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
r: h
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day as a Digital Marketing Manager at Conrad Dubai
li
Develop Digital Marketing Strategies: Create and execute strategies aligned with the hotel’s commercial objectives, brand positioning, and revenue targets.
li
Manage Paid Advertising: Plan and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and other platforms to drive awareness, engagement, bookings, and revenue.
li
Promote Hotel Experiences: Develop seasonal and always-on campaigns for Rooms, Restaurants, Brunches, Pool Experiences, Spa, Wellness, Events, E-Gift Cards, and E-Shop.
li
Optimise Campaign Performance: Manage audience targeting, remarketing, A/B testing, budgets, and conversion optimisation to maximise ROI and advertising effectiveness.
li
Manage OTA Platforms: Collaborate with Revenue Management and Commercial teams to optimise hotel listings, content accuracy, promotional offers, visibility, and bookings across third-party platforms.
li
Drive Spa and Wellness Revenue: Manage spa digital campaigns and online booking platforms to increase awareness, appointments, conversions, and repeat visits.
li
Optimise F&B Reservations: Oversee SevenRooms digital performance, enhancing reservation journeys and campaigns for restaurants, brunches, and pool experiences.
li
Generate Event Leads: Develop and optimise digital campaigns for MICE, corporate events, weddings, social celebrations, and group bookings, tracking enquiries through to confirmed business.
li
Maintain Website Excellence: Ensure hotel websites and approved digital platforms feature accurate information, compelling visuals, current offers, and seamless booking journeys.
li
Enhance WhatsApp Marketing: Drive campaign performance, improve enquiry handling, and track conversations, bookings, conversions, and attributed revenue.
li

Manage CRM and Email Marketing: Deliver targeted email campaigns, newsletters, and guest re-engagement initiatives to encourage repeat bookings and cross-selling while maintaining database accuracy and consent compliance.
li
Coordinate Social Media Content: Partner with Marketing and creative teams to align paid campaigns, organic content, photography, and promotional assets with luxury brand standards.
li
Strengthen Online Reputation: Monitor digital listings, search visibility, and guest feedback trends to maintain accurate information and a consistent luxury brand presence.
li
Analyse Digital Performance: Use Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and advertising dashboards to track conversions, revenue attribution, ROAS, ROI, CPA, and CPL.
li
Deliver Performance Reports: Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports with actionable insights, budget updates, campaign results, and recommendations.
li
Collaborate Across Departments: Work closely with Marketing, Commercial, Revenue Management, Sales, F&B, Spa, and Operations teams to align campaigns with business priorities.
li
Ensure Brand and Data Compliance: Maintain Hilton brand standards and ensure digital campaigns, guest databases, and communications meet corporate policies and applicable privacy requirements.
li
Drive Digital Innovation: Identify emerging technologies, hospitality trends, competitor activity, and new opportunities to enhance digital engagement and commercial performance.
li
Champion Exceptional Guest Experiences: Ensure every digital touchpoint reflects Conrad Dubai’s luxury positioning through thoughtful communication, attention to detail, and seamless guest journeys.

d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Director, Credit Product Lead for CEMEA will define and lead Visa’s regional credit product agenda across Central Europe, Middle East and Africa. The role will work closely with Regional and market leadership, Product, Advisory, Analytics, Risk and other cross-functional partners to accelerate sustainable credit growth across a highly diverse set of markets.

Credit growth is a key pillar of Visa’s 2030 strategy, and CEMEA represents one of the high potential regions for credit growth. This role will help determine where and how Visa captures that opportunity by identifying the priority markets, customer segments and product propositions for the next three to five years. With global credit card issuance continuing to expand, Visa is positioned to capture a disproportionate share of that growth if the right strategic, commercial and capability foundations are established now.

The role holder will translate this ambition into a practical regional strategy and market-level execution plans, combining Visa’s network, data, products, advisory capabilities and partnerships to expand responsible access to credit and strengthen client economics.

Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.

The position demands strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and a proven track record of recruiting, growing, and retaining technical talent. Directors are expected to drive consensus in cross-functional teams, forecast business trends, and translate insights into agile technology solutions. Exceptional communication and leadership skills are essential for influencing stakeholders and building credibility across regional and functional lines.
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
q: 12 or more years of experience including 5+ years building and managing cards and payments-linked credit businesses, with accountability for strategy, product development, portfolio performance and commercial outcomes.

Deep understanding of the credit value chain, including customer segmentation, proposition design, acquisition, underwriting, portfolio and line management, pricing, activation, engagement, collections, risk and profitability.
Strong knowledge of payments economics and lending business P&L; experience across multiple CEMEA markets or comparable emerging and developed markets is highly desirable.
Proven ability to translate strategy into market-level execution. This would include prioritization, business-case development, product launch, client commercialization and performance management.
Strong client leadership and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders across different cultures and market contexts.
Strategic thinking, strong analytical capability and financial acumen, with confidence using data to frame opportunities, make trade-offs and measure outcomes.
Track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed organization and delivering against demanding timelines.
Self-directed, collaborative and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a broad regional remit.
Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
r: li
Own and drive the CEMEA credit product strategy, including market prioritization, segment choices, product roadmap and commercial model with a three-to-five-year growth agenda.
li
Drive multiple levers of credit growth across diverse CEMEA markets, spanning countries with established/ mature credit businesses as well as emerging but high potential markets.
li

Accelerate credit adoption across emerging markets by enabling new-to-credit consumers and issuers through innovative and non-traditional credit products and propositions. This may include instalment-led, secured, ecosystem-based and alternative underwriting models that broaden access to responsible credit.
li

Support clients with the capabilities required to build, launch and scale sustainable credit businesses, including proposition design, acquisition, underwriting and portfolio strategy driving usage and risk-adjusted profitability.
li

Develop structured client upskilling programs that combine Visa expertise, data, advisory support, playbooks and market best practices, tailored to the maturity and regulatory context of individual CEMEA markets.
li

Build market-level opportunity assessments and business cases using consumer research, Visa data, competitive intelligence, portfolio economics and regulatory insights; convert these into clear investment and execution priorities.
li

Partner with Country Management, Sales, Product, Visa Consulting and Analytics, Risk, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Government Engagement and regional product teams to secure alignment and deliver coordinated execution.
li
Engage senior client stakeholders at financial institutions/fintechs, regulators and ecosystem partners to identify barriers to credit expansion and develop scalable solutions.
li
Establish performance metrics and governance for the regional credit agenda, track pipeline and portfolio outcomes, and provide regular updates and recommendations to CEMEA leadership.
li
Act as a trusted advisor and subject-matter expert on card and payments-linked credit, sharing global and regional best practice and representing CEMEA in global credit product forums.

d: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
5+ years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, audit, financial services, fintech, capital markets, exchange, custody, clearing, or digital assets.
Strong experience with monthly close, financial reporting, reconciliations, audit support, and internal controls.
Experience with SOX, regulatory reporting, process documentation, control testing, or remediation; exposure to VARA is strongly preferred.
Ability to understand end-to-end transaction flows and assess impacts across legal entities, systems, ledgers, and reporting outputs.
Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate independently across international time zones.
Familiarity with derivatives, digital assets, OmniLedger/ABOR, NetSuite, SQL, or finance analytics tools is preferred.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
